approval_record.authority_statement: Approved governance knowledge for immediate production use within the defined authority boundary. Legal interpretation, evidence adjudication, finding lock, residual-risk acceptance and lifecycle authorization remain attributable human decisions.
approval_record.change_control: Any semantic, state, gate, finding, source-applicability or tactic-mapping change requires a new version, dependency update, reciprocal validation and renewed approval.

domain_title: Purpose, value, context, roles and classification
title: Undefined or elastic intended purpose
canonical_definition: The system purpose is vague, technically framed, inconsistent or capable of expanding through features, users, data, workflows or decisions without explicit requalification and authorization.

applicability.statement: Applicable wherever an AI system or AI-enabled function has a declared or implied purpose, including experiments, internal tools, externally supplied systems and general-purpose components used in a specific context.
conditions: Assess both written purpose and reachable use.
Test scope expansion across lifecycle changes and operational practice.
Include indirect affected persons and downstream decision uses.
exclusions: Not applicable only when the component has no independent use context and its boundaries are fully assessed within a parent system.
reassessment_triggers: New purpose statement or product positioning
New audience, feature, data source, integration or decision role

primary_questions.question: Is the purpose vague, technically framed, conflicting or missing material users, affected persons, uses or decision boundaries?
Can workflows, access, data, features, tools or product behavior enable broader or different use than the approved purpose?
Does evidence show unauthorized scope expansion, or does a current scoped test establish the anti-pattern is absent?

required_evidence.title: Purpose statement corpus and inconsistency analysis
required_evidence.claim_supported: The system purpose is vague, technically framed, conflicting or materially incomplete.
acceptance_conditions: Collects current authoritative purpose statements across registration, product, contract, design and operational records.
Identifies contradictions, undefined terms and missing decision context.
limitations: A wording difference is not a finding unless it changes material scope or authority.

required_evidence.title: Reachable-use and audience comparison
required_evidence.claim_supported: Reachable users, functions or effects exceed the declared purpose or omit affected-person boundaries.
acceptance_conditions: Compares interfaces, access, features, integrations and workflows with declared users and uses.
Includes administrative, fallback and indirect-use paths.
limitations: A technically possible but inaccessible function is not automatically reachable use.

required_evidence.title: Permitted/prohibited-use enforceability test
required_evidence.claim_supported: Declared boundaries are too generic or unenforced to distinguish allowed, disallowed and misuse conditions.
acceptance_conditions: Executes representative boundary and misuse cases.
Records expected and actual control behavior for the current system version.
limitations: A policy review without executed tests cannot establish tested absence.

required_evidence.title: Purpose-change and scope-expansion history
required_evidence.claim_supported: Prototype, feature, audience, data or decision scope expanded without requalification.
acceptance_conditions: Traces material changes to impact analysis, reassessment and authorization records.
Identifies continued use before or without the required decision.
limitations: Normal maintenance inside an already approved boundary is not scope expansion.

required_evidence.title: Affected-person and downstream-impact review
required_evidence.claim_supported: Material affected persons or downstream uses are absent from the purpose boundary.
acceptance_conditions: Uses accountable domain, legal, risk and affected-person expertise.
limitations: A generic impact assessment not tied to the assessed system cannot resolve this claim.

required_evidence.title: Scoped absence-test package
required_evidence.claim_supported: A current, executed and independently reviewed test covers all material AP-A1 failure mechanisms.
acceptance_conditions: Covers vague purpose, conflicting statements, missing users/affected persons, unenforced use boundaries and unauthorized scope expansion.
Identifies system version, scope, test cases, results, residual limitations and independent reviewer.
limitations: Silence, missing incidents, document presence or unsuccessful discovery is never TESTED_ABSENT.

evidence_ceilings: Document inconsistency can establish a declaration gap but not the complete reachable-use surface.
Implementation comparison can establish reachable divergence but not frequency or operational consequence.
Operational history can establish observed scope expansion only for covered periods and change records.
TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete absence-test contract; no lower assurance state can be interpreted as absence.
false_positive_guards: Do not treat concise wording as vague when the controlled definitions and linked boundaries are precise.
Do not treat a general-purpose model as an undefined-purpose system when the deployed use is system-specifically bounded.
Do not treat every feature change as scope expansion; test whether users, decisions, data, effects or risk materially changed.
Do not infer a missing affected-person boundary solely from absence of direct end users.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer absence from no reported misuse, no complaint, no incident or no detected contradiction.
Do not infer an approved scope change from release, backlog, technical enablement or stakeholder demand.
Do not infer legal non-compliance solely from AP-A1 presence.
Do not infer a broad purpose is acceptable because the underlying model is marketed as general-purpose.
contradiction_handling: Conflicting authoritative statements establish at least UNKNOWN and may support presence when the conflict changes material scope.
Where declared and reachable use conflict, preserve both evidence paths and assess the broader reachable boundary.
Human adjudication is required where business, legal and technical authorities disagree about the operative purpose.
freshness_rules: Use the current production, pilot or evaluation version and current authoritative statements.
Repeat absence testing after any material change.
Operational and change records must cover the period in which the alleged expansion could have occurred.

conditions: Block consequential deployment when the anti-pattern is confirmed or materially present.
Constrain operation to an evidenced narrow scope when purpose or reachable-use boundaries remain UNKNOWN.
Block material expansion when requalification or authorization is missing.

normative_source_mappings.exact_locator: Article 3(12) intended purpose; Article 3(13) reasonably foreseeable misuse; Article 11 and Annex IV; Article 13
normative_source_mappings.category_rationale: Supports assessment of inconsistent, incomplete or elastic purpose and mismatch between supplied information, technical documentation and actual reachable use when the Regulation applies.

normative_source_mappings.exact_locator: AI RMF Core MAP 1.1, MAP 1.3, MAP 2.2, MAP 3.3 and MANAGE 1.1; Playbook MAP 1.1
normative_source_mappings.category_rationale: Supports testing whether context, users, limitations, acceptable use and changing operational conditions are explicit and continually reassessed.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose is vague, general-purpose or technically framed without a testable decision context
finding_definitions.lifecycle_consequence: Prevent consequential progression until a system-specific purpose and decision context are approved.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose statements conflict or omit material users, affected persons, permitted or prohibited uses
finding_definitions.lifecycle_consequence: Constrain the system to the narrowest evidenced boundary and require authoritative reconciliation.

finding_definitions.title: Reachable implementation or operations exceed the approved purpose boundary
finding_definitions.lifecycle_consequence: Stop or disable the divergent path until controls and authorization restore alignment.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose or use scope expanded without requalification and authorization
finding_definitions.lifecycle_consequence: Suspend the expanded use and require material-change reassessment and formal decision.

finding_definitions.title: Absence of undefined or elastic purpose is not established by a scoped current test
finding_definitions.lifecycle_consequence: Do not report TESTED_ABSENT; retain UNKNOWN until the complete absence-test contract is satisfied.

machine_may: Extract and compare purpose statements, system behavior, use records and change evidence.
Identify missing, conflicting, stale or scope-mismatched evidence.
Apply deterministic evidence ceilings and propose eligible conclusion states for human lock.
Test exact approved tactic mappings after a finding is locked.
machine_must_not: Define the organization's purpose or risk appetite.
Treat legal vocabulary as a legal-applicability conclusion.
Raise assurance beyond the evidence ceiling.
Clear the hard gate, accept residual risk, authorize a new use or lifecycle transition.
Change or close a locked finding because a tactic was selected or completed.
human_authority_required_for: Approve intended purpose and use boundaries.
Lock findings and accept residual risk.
Authorize constrained operation, deployment, expansion, requalification or retirement.

failure_mechanism: Ambiguous or inconsistent intent allows technical capability, stakeholder demand, prototypes and incremental features to redefine accepted use without corresponding control design, evaluation, affected-person analysis, risk review or accountable authorization.

atomic_tests.test: Compare authoritative purpose statements and determine whether the problem, intended task or decision and operating context are materially specific and mutually consistent.
Test whether purpose wording is merely a technical capability, product category or generic business aspiration rather than a bounded socio-technical use.
Determine whether intended users, operators and affected persons, including indirect groups, are explicit and complete for the reachable use.
Determine whether permitted uses, prohibited uses and foreseeable misuse are concrete enough to distinguish compliant and non-compliant behavior.
Determine whether expected outputs, downstream decision use and non-authorized effects are absent, conflicting or materially open-ended.
Compare reachable access, features, data, tools, integrations, administrative paths and fallback behavior with the approved purpose boundary.
Execute representative permitted-use, prohibited-use and misuse cases to determine whether the system prevents, constrains or observes boundary violations.
Trace material changes and actual use to determine whether prototype, feature, audience, data or decision scope expanded before requalification and authorization.
Execute and independently review a complete scoped absence test covering every material AP-A1 mechanism for the current system version and operating boundary.

required_artifacts: Independent review record and residual limitation statement
